import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.svm import SVC
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss
from scipy.sparse import hstack

# Set random seed for reproducibility
np.random.seed(42)

# Load data
train = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_submission = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")


# Create hold-out validation set from the training data
# Split BEFORE feature extraction to ensure genuine hold-out
train_idx, val_idx = train_test_split(
    range(len(train)), test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=train["author"]
)

# Prepare labels for train and validation splits
train_subset = train.iloc[train_idx]
val_subset = train.iloc[val_idx]
train_labels = np.array([author for author in train_subset["author"]])
val_labels = np.array([author for author in val_subset["author"]])

# Fit TF-IDF on TRAINING DATA ONLY
word_vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    max_features=10000, ngram_range=(1, 3), min_df=2, max_df=0.95, sublinear_tf=True
)

X_word_train = word_vectorizer.fit_transform(train_subset["text"])
X_word_val = word_vectorizer.transform(val_subset["text"])
X_word_test = word_vectorizer.transform(test["text"])

# Combine train and validation data for feature statistics if needed
X_train_full = hstack([X_word_train, X_word_val])
X_train = X_word_train
X_val = X_word_val

# Train SVM classifier with probability estimates
clf = SVC(kernel="linear", probability=True, random_state=42, C=1.0)
clf.fit(X_train, train_labels)

# Predict on validation set and calculate log-loss
val_pred = clf.predict_proba(X_val)

# Calculate log-loss metric on hold-out validation set
val_logloss = log_loss(val_labels, val_pred)
print(f"Validation Log-Loss: {val_logloss:.6f}")

# Generate predictions for test set
test_pred = clf.predict_proba(X_word_test)

# Create submission file
submission = pd.DataFrame(
    {
        "id": test["id"],
        "EAP": test_pred[:, 0],
        "HPL": test_pred[:, 1],
        "MWS": test_pred[:, 2],
    }
)

# Save to required location
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print("Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
print(f"Submission shape: {submission.shape}")
